lines.say: Nearly seven hours stuck on a snowy Alabama highway, with no food or water.
A Chick fil A by the road was snowed in too, so the staff decided to feed them.
Several hundred sandwiches, handed out free, that Wednesday in January twenty fourteen.
The manager said drivers were especially surprised that they were free.
Your quiet clients aren't snowed in, but they'll remember who texted first. Hey Jay, got you a spot Thursday.
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
